atlas_routes.ATLAS:X: authority -> source -> literal -> theme -> L/O/T memory -> relations -> scale -> evidence -> gate -> delta -> index
atlas_routes.L:X: preserve predecessor records and negative results; corrections append successors
atlas_routes.O:X: separate authority, data custody, covariance, likelihood parity, baseline recovery, inference, perturbations and independent replication
atlas_routes.T:X: Mapa authority/index <-> RLL producer implementation <-> evidence artifacts
atlas_routes.SCALE:X: META program -> gate -> claim -> dataset/version -> file/blob/hash -> executable receipt
atlas_routes.EVID:X: promotion requires exact evidence pointers and gate-specific falsifiers
atlas_routes.GAP:X: missing evidence remains TOKEN_VAZIO or BLOCKED; absence is never coerced to PASS
atlas_routes.LEARN:X: append-only successor; gate maturity and evidence custody may not silently regress

gates.required_output: exact URL/version/terms/SHA256/transformation receipt per consumed file
gates.falsifier: any consumed dataset lacks exact identity, rights decision, checksum, or transformation receipt

gates.required_output: units, ordering, covariance dimensions and semantics for every data vector
gates.falsifier: schema, units, ordering, or vector/covariance dimensions are ambiguous or inconsistent

gates.required_output: validated full covariance or explicitly justified block structure
gates.falsifier: covariance cannot be reproduced, is misordered, non-finite, dimensionally inconsistent, or omits required correlations

gates.required_output: same data, nuisance treatment and covariance for RLL and every adversary
gates.falsifier: RLL and baseline models are evaluated with unequal data, priors, nuisance policy, covariance, or stopping criteria

gates.required_output: recover published LCDM/wCDM/CPL behavior within declared tolerance
gates.falsifier: reference baselines cannot be recovered under the frozen pipeline within preregistered tolerances

gates.required_output: multi-seed convergence, posterior diagnostics, prior sensitivity and real Bayesian evidence
gates.falsifier: non-convergence, prior-dominated result, unstable seeds, or reliance on BIC/AIC proxy as Bayesian evidence

gates.required_output: physical perturbation/growth prediction with CLASS/CAMB-equivalent validation before growth/CMB claims
gates.falsifier: no stable physical perturbation/growth solution or failure to recover baseline growth behavior

gates.required_output: explicit claim decision preserving negative results and independent falsifier outcome
gates.falsifier: any G0-G6 prerequisite is below VERIFIED or independent replication is unresolved

F_ok: canonical RLL producer repository, branch, HEAD and tree are now pinned
G0-G7 source states are materialized into one machine-readable ATLAS promotion record
existing TOKEN_VAZIO closure ledger is consumed as blocker authority rather than replaced
F_gap: G5 robust inference and real Bayesian evidence
F_next: freeze one rights-cleared full likelihood and covariance, then run identical LCDM/wCDM/CPL/RLL baselines with robust multi-seed diagnostics; preserve the negative smoke baseline
